tasks.label: Build Debug Plugin (Windows)
args: cmake --build build_x64 --config Debug --target c64stream; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:/ProgramData/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/bin/64bit' -Force | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:/ProgramData/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data' -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}/build_x64/Debug/c64stream.dll' -Destination 'C:/ProgramData/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/bin/64bit/' -Force; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}/data/*' -Destination 'C:/ProgramData/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/' -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}/README.md' -Destination 'C:/ProgramData/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/README.md' -Force; Write-Host 'Plugin installed to C:/ProgramData/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream'

tasks.label: Install Plugin to OBS (Windows)
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\c64stream\bin\64bit' -Force | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\c64stream\data' -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}\build_x64\Debug\c64stream.dll' -Destination 'C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\c64stream\bin\64bit\' -Force; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}\data\*' -Destination 'C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\c64stream\data\' -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}\README.md' -Destination 'C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\c64stream\data\README.md' -Force; Write-Host 'Plugin installed to C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\c64stream'

tasks.label: VSCode: Install Plugin to OBS (Linux)
args: mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/bin/64bit" && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data" && cp "build_x86_64/c64stream.so" "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/bin/64bit/" && cp -r "data"/* "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/" && cp "README.md" "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/README.md" && if [ -f "build_x86_64/generated/prg/av-sync-auto.prg" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/prg" && cp "build_x86_64/generated/prg/av-sync-auto.prg" "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/prg/"; fi && echo 'Plugin installed successfully'

tasks.label: Clean Build (Windows)
args: if (Test-Path 'build_x64') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'build_x64'; Write-Host 'Cleaned build_x64' } else { Write-Host 'No build_x64 directory to clean' }

tasks.label: Clean Build (Linux)
args: if [ -d 'build_x86_64' ]; then rm -rf build_x86_64 && echo 'Cleaned build_x86_64'; else echo 'No build_x86_64 directory to clean'; fi

tasks.label: Linux: Build and Install Plugin
args: echo 'Building plugin...' && cmake --build build_x86_64 && echo 'Installing plugin...' && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/bin/64bit" && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data" && cp "build_x86_64/c64stream.so" "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/bin/64bit/" && cp -r "data"/* "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/" && if [ -f "build_x86_64/generated/prg/av-sync-auto.prg" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/prg" && cp "build_x86_64/generated/prg/av-sync-auto.prg" "$HOME/.config/obs-studio/plugins/c64stream/data/prg/"; fi && echo 'Plugin build and install completed successfully!'
